# origincloud_iam_role_binding (Resource)

One role granted to one member, organization-wide or in one project. A binding can't be changed: delete it and create another.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `member` (String) Who holds the role: `user:{email}` or `serviceAccount:{service_account}`. A user is shown with their account's current verified address, as `userId:{user}` when it has none, or as `deleted:user:{user}` once the account is gone. Changing it replaces the role binding.
- `organization` (String) The organization the role binding is in. Changing it replaces the role binding.
- `role` (String) The role granted, `roles/{role}`. Changing it replaces the role binding.

### Optional

- `project` (String) The project the binding is limited to, `projects/{project}`, one of the organization's. Empty for a binding on the whole organization, which covers every project in it. Changing it replaces the role binding.

### Read-Only

- `create_time` (String) When the binding was created. An RFC 3339 timestamp, such as `2026-11-01T12:00:00Z`.
- `creator` (String) Who created the binding, written as a member is, or `platform` for a binding the platform made itself. Always `userId:{user}` for a user in a list of the caller's own bindings (`organizations/-`).
- `id` (String) The role binding's resource name, the same as `name`.
- `name` (String) The binding's resource name.
- `urn` (String) The binding's URN, the identifier access policies and the audit log use.
